integrity: Complete human-readable proof and a standalone finite exhaustive verification program are supplied; no external certificate or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite complete multipartite graphs having at least three nonempty parts.

The common-neighbor feasibility rule is a known consequence of a generic characterization. The balanced bipartite all-set formula and pure two-cut-complex shellability are prior knowledge, not claimed new.

The integral homotopy claim is proved by a matroid-shellability and suspension argument; numerical computations verify only small examples, and mod-two computations do not establish integral torsion-freeness.
Publication priority is provisional: an unindexed treatment or a succinct specialization of broader published machinery might cover the combined classification.
The current review is same-model only; no independent mathematical audit or validation has been performed.
title: Nonpure sphere-wedge total-visibility complexes of complete multipartite graphs
